Standard: Impulse noise levels resulting from the escape system, measured at the ear canal (inside the helmet) at each crew station, are less than 140 dBP. For noise exposures where the peak pressure level is 140 dBP or greater, as measured at the ear canal (inside the helmet) or external to the helmet using the helmet impulsive peak insertion loss at each crewmember position, the LIAeq8hr does not exceed steady-state levels of 85 dBA or 140 dBP, as calculated IAW MIL-STD-1474, Compute the LIAeq for a Single Impulse paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) The LIAeq8hr does not exceed steady-state levels 85 dBA or 140 dBP, as calculated IAW MIL- STD-1474, Compute the LIAeq for a Single Impulse paragraph. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Testing verifies the sound pressure level measurements at each crewmember position IAW the standard.
